svg.title: Air-domain MRO availability: lifecycle propagation and connected response
svg.desc: A repair release recorded locally is not shared, leaving collection untriggered, a usable part invisible, replacement uncertain and return to service at risk. Emergency response and extra stock can follow. Potential impacts include reduced aircraft availability and increased decision delay, sustainment cost, contingency stock, working capital tied up and assurance effort. The lifecycle insight connects release, handover, availability, fleet impact and an owned response. Potential business outcomes are earlier intervention, fewer avoidable expedites, less precautionary stock and more credible readiness plans. Reconstructed as vector shapes and outlined text from the supplied Air Domain.png.

path.aria-label: Time and uncertainty compound the impact
